name: lexicon-pdf
reason: A C wrapper over the Poppler GLib engine has a documented local PDF API, but its upstream has no tagged release and no pinned control adapter has been verified; it would share the Poppler parser family.

name: zathura-pdf-poppler
reason: Official 2026.07.18 plugin is a C PDF backend over Poppler, but its documented document_open callback is invoked by the Zathura host with a zathura_document_t. The host build exposes a static internal library and plugin API; no standalone consumer adapter with a valid local PDF and observable parsed output has been established. It would share the Poppler parser family.
